crossRefs.note: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field…
Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians…
For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of…
It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the…
Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
